en.prompt: 7. Which rays are convenient for constructing an image formed by a lens?
en.displayAnswer:
For a converging thin lens, three convenient rays are:
1. A ray incident parallel to the principal axis, which refracts through the image-side focus.
2. A ray passing through the object-side focus before the lens, which emerges parallel to the principal axis.
3. A ray through the optical center, whose direction is unchanged in the thin-lens approximation.
Usually two independent rays locate the image point: actual refracted rays intersect for a real image, while backward extensions intersect for a virtual image.
For a diverging lens, the backward extension of a refracted parallel-incident ray passes through the image-side virtual focus; an incident ray aimed at the corresponding focus on the outgoing side emerges parallel.
For an object point on the principal axis, the three special rays may coincide. Choose another nonaxial ray and use the image-side focal plane; the same line is not two independent rays.

At exactly normal incidence, a zero incident angle makes the product law require a zero transmitted angle for positive indices. Both segments lie on the normal. The new second line expressly states this in both languages and confines the opposite-sides clause to oblique incidence.

At oblique incidence with a propagating transmitted ray, the incoming and outgoing geometrical segments lie on opposite sides of the normal in the incidence plane. The repaired qualification retains this usual construction rather than changing the law.
At normal incidence the incidence plane is not unique, but a plane containing the normal contains both collinear segments; the first-line coplanarity statement is not contradicted.

A line through the converging lens's object-side focus has exactly that incoming slope, so its outgoing ray is parallel whether or not the focus is on the actual incident segment.

correct_explanation_candidate.zh: 对理想会聚薄透镜，常选三类近轴光线：平行于主轴的光线，折射后经过像方主焦点；入射支撑直线经过物方主焦点的光线，折射后平行于主轴；通过光心的光线，在同介质薄透镜近似下方向不变。通常两条不同且独立的光线即可定位有限像，第三条可核对；实像用出射光线交点，虚像用反向延长线交点。轴上物点会使这三条标准线重合为主轴，须另取不同孔径高度的近轴光线，不能把重合线当成独立定位依据。发散透镜应使用相应的虚焦点及延长线规则。
correct_explanation_candidate.en: For an ideal converging thin lens, use three convenient paraxial rays: a ray parallel to the principal axis refracts through the image-side principal focus; a ray whose incident supporting line passes through the object-side principal focus leaves parallel to the axis; and a ray through the optical center is undeviated in the same-medium thin-lens approximation. Two distinct independent rays usually locate a finite image, and a third can check it. Intersect outgoing rays for a real image or their backward extensions for a virtual image. For an on-axis point the three standard rays can coincide with the axis, so use distinct rays at other aperture heights. A diverging lens uses the corresponding virtual-focus and extension rules.
